verdict.rationale: Munito AI states it is "Private by default, zero data retention. No training on your data," and its llms.txt describes it as an inference provider that is "private by default." Customer data is excluded from training by default, with no opt-out step needed. Missing for 10: detailed first-party policy or contractual documentation (e.g., terms/DPA language on training exclusion), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond the marketing-page claim.
